balls.text: short ball and Raje tries to hook it, he doesn't make proper contact and collects a single behind square, excellent last over, just six off it
Raje lines Yo Mahesh up and tries to launch him over deep midwicket, Yo Mahesh sticks to an excellent line just outside off and beats the bat
full and wide outside off stump, Raje throws his bat at it and slices the ball behind point for four, third man can't run quickly enough to cut it off
full ball outside off stump, Raje tries to slog it on the leg side but misses

caught in the deep! Yo Mahesh bowls a full toss, Pollock tries to smash it over long on but doesn't time it well, he lots the ball towards AB de Villiers in the deep who sprints in from the boundary and holds on to a well-judged catch, he was running in at pace and did well to time the catch perfectly
Raje chips a full ball towards long on to give Pollock the strike
super! Pollock once again backs away to create room, Asif bowls a short ball and Pollock swings his bat hard and pulls the ball powerfully over the deep square leg boundary, 22 runs off the over

what a shot that is! Pollock moves towards the leg side to create room, Asif bowls it full and outside off stump, Pollock reaches out for it and throws his bat hard at it, he connects and slices the ball high over the point boundary
banged in short by Asif, Pollock was moving towards leg side and Asif followed him, he was a bit too much down leg side and Koertzen signals another wide
he's smashed that! Pollock backs away towards leg side and lofts a full toss from Asif dead straight over the boundary, unlike Tiwary he's connected well and timed it beautifully
full and wide outside off stump, Pollock misses the drive and Asif appeals for the caught behind, Koertzen calls it wide and rightly so

caught! splendidly caught! Tiwary gets under a low full toss, hits it with the bottom of the bat and lofts it straight down the ground, Malik runs towards his left from long-on and takes an excellent sliding catch
full delivery nearly in the block hole, Pollock makes room and lofts the ball towards long-on for one more
good length delivery outside of stump, Tiwary backs away and drives through cover for one

McGrath ends his spell with a poor ball, it's a full toss outside off stump that Pollock slices to the point boundary, McGrath kicks the turf in disappointment but he's finished with figures of 0 for 26 off four overs, an excellent spell
excellent ball in the block hole, Tiwary can't do much about it but dig it out towards mid-off for one
a low full toss on off stump, Pollock moves towards leg side and drives to the fielder on the sweeper boundary, just the single
the slower ball bowled full on middle stump, Tiwary hits it hard to midwicket and he would have been out had the throw back to McGrath been a good one
full ball in the block hole outside off stump, Pollock defends on the off side
full ball outside off stump, Pollock backs away towards leg, makes room and dives inside out towards deep cover where Sangwan makes an excellent stop
full ball on middle and off, Tiwary clears his front foot out of the way and tries to smash the ball down the ground but ends up mis-timing the shot back to Asif
fuller length on off and middle, Pollock moves forward and pushes the ball towards midwicket for one
Pollock makes room again but Asif seams the ball away from the right-hander and beats the bat
Pollock makes room and pulls a short of  a length ball towards deep backward square leg, two fielders run towards the ball, one from fine leg the other from deep square but the ball splits the gap
Pollock tries to moves towards the leg side to make room , Asif follows him with a good length ball and cramps him, Pollock defends in a hurry
good length delivery outside of stump, Tiwary waits on the back foot and cuts towards third man for a single
Tiwary moves across his stumps and chips the ball towards fine leg, just the single and he will retain strike
defended on the front foot towards the off side
Tiwary tries to defend off the back foot and gets an inside edge that runs to the fine leg boundary, that was a quicker ball from Malik
bowled flat and quick outside off stump, Tiwary drives off the front foot to cover
played off the pads through midwicket for  a single

he strikes first ball! Bravo charges down the track and tries to blast it into orbit, he gets under the ball and hits hit high high in the air, he hasn't got enough distance on it though and Yo Mahesh settles under a swirling catch at long on and holds on to it
tossed up on off stump, Pollock moves forward and drives towards cover
bowled him! Sehwag bowls one flat and straight and a bit quicker, Nayar backs away and tries to cut he misses and Sehwag hits the stumps, Mumbai are unravelling fast here
Nayar tries to play the slog sweep but doesn't make contact
that's a high full toss and Bravo fulls it towards deep backward square leg for a single, he didn't connect properly, it was really too high but it hasn't been called a no ball
pushed through midwicket for  a quick single
bowled flat on leg and middle, played off the back foot towards the leg side
another slower ball on off and middle stump, Bravo moves forward and drives towards mid-on
slower ball on the pads, Nayar turns it off his pads behind square for  a single
fullish length outside off stump, Nayar tries to drive through the off side on the front foot but mis-times it towards the bowler

bowled! That was a clever change of pace from Bhatia, Thornely tried to slog across the line and was way too early on the shot, he missed the ball completely and the ball crashed into off and middle stump
shot! Thornely stands in his crease, plants his front foot forward and lofts Bhatia cleanly through the line over the straight boundary, super hit
good length ball on off stump, driven off the back foot through cover

caught! Uthappa comes forward and tries to scoop a full ball over short fine leg a la Misbah ul Haq, he gets a leading edge and the ball flies high and straight to Shoaib Malik who takes an easy catch behind square on the leg side

that's lucky for Thornely! He tries to pull off the front foot but gets beaten by a slower ball, he was into the short too early and the outside edge just flew wide of Karthik who dived full stretch to his right
Uthappa tries to loft over long on again but mis-times it and plays the ball along the ground
driven firmly to the fielder on the sweeper boundary
massive! Thornely walks across his stumps to get inside the line of a short ball, he's got himself into an excellent position and pulls the ball over the fine leg boundary
Uthappa walks down the pitch at Sangwan who bowls a full ball on off stump, Uthappa steers it towards third man for one
Uthappa stays on the back foot and opens the face late to play the ball towards third man
Uthappa tries to play a deft late cut to a good length ball outside off but misses
and again! This time Uthappa moves across his stumps and lofts a fullish delivery over deep midwicket, he's smashed it with a lot of power, consecutive sixes
full toss and Uthappa's whacked it! He moved forward and across and lofted it cleanly over long on, that cleared the boundary by several yards, clean crisp hit
tight line and length on off stump, Uthappa walks across his stumps and defends back to the bowler
too full and too straight, Thornely move forward and lofts the ball hard and flat down the ground, Yo Mahesh cuts it off at long on
full ball outside off stump, Thornely moves forward and drives it past Dhawan at point for a single

missed run out, good length delivery outside off stump, Uthappa drives towards point where Dhawan dives to his right and makes a fine save, there's a mix up between the batsmen and had Dhawan hit the stumps at the striker's end Thornely would have been yards short
Uthappa takes a walk down the pitch, trying to throw the bowler off his length, Sangwan sees his coming and fires in a quick bouncer, Uthappa tries to hook but misses
full ball outside off stump, driven through covers for  a single
a low full toss on middle stump, Thornely backs away and smashes the ball straight back at Sangawan who sticks his left hand out and saves a boundary, terrific effort from the under-19 kid
good length delivery pitches around off stump and slants across the right-hander, Uthappa waits for it and runs the ball down to third man
good length delivery on leg stump, Thornely move forward and plays the ball off his pads towards midwicket
shot! The length was too full on middle stump and Thornely leaned forward and drove the ball smoothly to the straight boundary
and another one shoots through after pitching outside off stump on a good length, Thornely tries to hit through the off side, he misses and the low bounce beats Karthik as well
full ball outside off stump, Thornely backs away and tries to hit through the off side, the ball rolls after pitch on its way through to Karthik
short of a length delivery outside off stump, Thornely comes forward and drags it from off stump over the fielder at mid-on for his first boundary
banged in short and down leg side, Thornely tries to hook but can't connect, the umpire doesn't call it wide
good length delivery on middle stump, Uthappa moves forward and defends towards midwicket
pushed off the front foot towards mid-off

full ball outside off stump, Thornely moves across towards off stump and tries to flick off his pads, he misses and gets hit on the pads, Sangwan appeals but he's forgotten that a batsman can't be out lbw off a free hit
full ball outside off stump, Uthappa waits in his crease and steers it towards third man, free hit coming up
loud appeal for caught behind, from Karthik at least, Sangawan bowled a short ball and Uthappa missed the hook, Karthik caught it and ran towards Sangwan, the bowler didn't go up for it
full delivery outside off stump, Thornely backs away toward leg side and drives the ball to the fielder on the sweeper boundary
Thornely takes a step forward and pulls a slightly short ball powerfully towards mid-on
full ball outside off stump, Uthappa leans forward and drives powerfully but he doesn't find the gap in the infield
Thornely backs away towards leg stump to make room, Yomahesh follows him with a good length ball that angles into him, Thornely cuts off the back foot towards third man
good length delivery angling into middle stump, Uthappa moves forward and pushes the ball towards mid-on for  a single
played towards Sangwan at third man for a single, bit of a boundary drought at the moment
good length once again outside off stump, Uthappa waits in his crease and pushes the ball behind point for a single
fullish length on off stump, Uthappa moves forward and pushes the ball towards mid off
good length delivery at 128 kmh, Thornely stays in his crease and defends towards the off side
short of a length delivery from over the wicket, the ball rises on Thornely who jumps up to defend the ball down on the leg side
fuller delivery outside off stump, Uthappa leans forward and drives towards deep cover for another single
short of a length delivery outside off stump, Thornely moves back and dabs the ball behind point for  a single
Uthappa pushes the ball towards cover for another single
full and wide outside off stump, driven off the front foot to sweeper cover

bowled him! Jayasuriya tries to loft Yomahesh over square leg once again, the line is on off stump and this time Jayasuriya misses and the ball crashes into and uproots off stump, he went back to play the ball but the length was too full, 15 runs and two wickets off that over and Yomahesh is thrilled

Jayasuriya charges down the pitch, Yomahesh sees his coming and bowls it full and wide outside off stump, Jayasuriya reaches out for it and tries to hit through the off side, he connects with the bottom of the bat and the ball runs past the wicketkeeper for four

caught! Takawale tries to go after Yomahesh as well, he was looking to hit straight down the ground but the thick outside edge flew straight to Sangwan at third man who took a well judged but easy catch
Jayasuriya moves across once again and lofts Yomahesh over square leg, there's a fielder in the deep now
short of a length on leg stump, Jayasuriya moves across and plays the ball past the fielder at short fine leg for four
Jayasuriya! He moves towards the off side and picks a full ball off his pads and swings the ball high and far over square leg, that is the first six of the innings
short of a length delivery on off stump, Takawale waits in his crease and defends on the off side
now that's extremely well struck! McGrath over-pitches outside off stump, Takawale leans forward and drives the ball superbly through covers for four, that should increase his confidence

Takawale decides it's time to go and he charges McGrath, trying to slog him down the ground, he gets an inside edge that runs past his stumps towards the fine leg boundary, Karthik gives chase but he can't reach it
excellent short ball angles into the right-hander from outside off stump, Takawale sways out of the way, he is struggling to build his momentum
good length delivery outside off stump, it was the slower one, Takawale tries to cut but misses
that isn't short enough to pull but Jayasuriya tries to play it anyway, he manages to play it down towards fine leg, he thought it was running for four so didn't push for the second, poor running
Asif bowls another short ball, Takawale ducks under it and lets it go, I thought the umpire had already signaled one for the over when Asif bowled the wide earlier?
short and wide outside off stump, Jayasuriya moves towards the ball and cuts powerfully through cover point, there's a fielder on the point boundary
and he makes it count! Jayasuriya stands in his crease and lofts a full ball from outside off over mid-on, the ball bounces once before going over the boundary
good length on off and middle stump from Asif, Takawale moves forward and nudges the ball towards midwicket for a quick single
banged in short down leg side, Takawale lets the ball go and Howell calls it wide, it was well over the batsman's head
good length delivery outside off stump, Takawale moves forward and pushes the ball towards point
Takawale plays a really good looking shot but he's not timed it at all, he moved forward to a short of a length ball and tried to loft it down the ground, he just about cleared mid-on
good length delivery on middle stump, Takawale moves across and plays the ball off hid pads towards long leg for  a single, he retains the strike
short of a length delivery on off stump, Jayasuriya dabs it towards the off side and sets off for the single
width offered outside off stump, Takawale uses it to cut the ball down to third man
good length delivery angles into the right-hander from outside off, Takawale defends on the off side, I realise he's making his debut and he's facing McGrath but he needs to get a move on
banged in short, Takawale moves forward and tries to hook but was in no position whatsoever to make contact
good length delivery angles into middle stump, Takawale moves forward and plays the ball towards midwicket
a good length ball pitches on middle and seams across the left-hander, Jayasuriya moves forward and defends
short of a length on leg and middle, Jayasuriya tries to work it towards fine leg but doesn't make proper contact
the length is full on off stump and Jayasuriya gets under the ball and lofts it over cover on the front foot, the ball plugs in the outfield after it pitches but just manages to reach the fence
a bit too straight from Asif, on leg and middle stump, Jayasuriya walks across his stumps and plays the leg glance, there's no fine leg so Jayasuriya collects his second boundary
short of a length delivery outside off stump, Takwale goes back in his crease, waits for the ball and opens the face of the bat to play it behind point towards third man for a single
good length delivery on off stump, Takwale waits in his crease and defends back towards the bowler
McGrath comes back to pitch on an impeccable length and slants across the left-hander, left alone by Jayasuriya
too full outside off stump, Jayasuriya leans on to the front foot and drives the ball firmly into the gap at cover, the outfield is quick and that is four, the DY Patil Stadium finds its voice
McGrath appeals for leg before, Jayasuriya moved forward and across to defend but got hit on the pad by a good length ball that angled across the left hander, that was missing off
good length delivery angling into middle and leg stump, Takwale tries to work the ball off his pads but gets hit on the legs for a leg bye behind square
short of a length and wide outside off stump, the ball moves away from the right-hander, Takwale begins to reach out for it but pulls his bat out of the way eventually
McGrath pitches the ball on a perfect length outside off stump, Takwale moves forward and lets the ball go through to Karthik

and he lasts just two balls! McGrath tries to loft the ball over the infield on the off side, he slices the ball high in the air, Thornely runs backwards from cover and takes the catch, the DY Patil stadium erupts and the players are thrilled, what a match they have had toppling the table-leaders Delhi
short of a length outside off stump, McGrath tries to cut but gets beaten
Yo Mahesh hits a full toss towards long on for  a single, he'll need to do better than that
Yo Mahesh backs away to make room but Kulkarni follows him with a full ball, the batsman gets beaten
caught! good length ball angles across the left-hander, Asif tries to pull towards the leg side but the outside edge flies straight to Nehra who holds the catch at third man
the batsman tries to drive down the ground but gets an outside edge towards third man, three runs and two wickets off the over from Nehra, priceless bowling at the death
good length delivery angles across the right-hander, Yo Mahesh tries to hit the ball through cover but gets beaten
good length delivery pitches around off stump and seams across the right-hander, the batsman tries to drive and gets beaten

Bhatia's holed out! That has to be it for Delhi, Bhatia gets a full toss and tries to smash it out of the ground, he mis-times the shot straight to Uthappa at long on who takes an easy catch an then doffs his cap to the appreciative  Mumbai crowd in celebration

caught! Sangwan tries to clear the long off boundary but doesn't time it well, he hits it in the air towards Tiwary who runs in from the boundary and holds on to the catch, that was dipping on Tiwary and he timed his run and slide extremely well
a high full toss outside off stump, pulled towards long on for  a single
Bhatia tries to work a full ball off his pads but doesn't make contact, they run leg byes towards short fine leg
Bhatia gets under a length ball and swings powerfully, he's connected well and lofts it cleanly over long on, crucial six for Delhi
the slower ball angles into the right-hander, Sangwan tried to defend and was hit on the back pad, Bravo appeals confidently but Koertzen says not out this time, they run a leg bye
bowled full on middle and leg stump, flicked off the pads behind square for two more
he chips a slower ball in the air towards short extra cover, Bravo is fast but not that fast!

a full ball slants into middle stump, Karthik moves across his stumps and tries to flick, he misses and gets hit on the pad plumb in front of middle stump, he was a long way across his stumps and Koertzen raises the finger, the Mumbai Indians mob Bravo in celebration, the DY Patil explodes in sound, fantastic scenes

excellent ball in the block hole on middle stump, Bhatia digs it out on the off side, Karthik sets off for the single and stops, Bhatia too sets off and then stops, five runs off the over, fabulous effort from Raje
pulled towards deep backward square for one

a slow and full ball on off stump, Bhatia lofts the ball straight over the bowler's head and the ball is headed for  a certain boundary until Nehra puts in a full length dive and saves it, terrific effort
Bhatia tries to slog a good length ball outside off towards the leg side and misses completely, he was nearly bowled
a slow and low full toss on leg and middle, Karthik moves across and sweeps towards deep backward square leg for  a single

short and wide outside off stump, Karthik cuts off the back foot to deep point and sets off for the single, he comes back for the second and puts in an extremely long dive, the throw was poor and the keeper took a while to whip off the bails and Karthik was just in, just
cut off the back foot towards third man

well fielded! Karthik tries to loft a slower ball over long on, he doesn't time it well but clears Bravo who was at mid on, Bravo sprinted after the ball and tapped it in just as it was going over the boundary, excellent save
tight line and length from Pollock, dead straight on off and middle, defended on the front foot towards the bowler
good length delivery on off stump, Bhatia moves forward and drives through cover for  a single
played with an open face towards third man for  a single

caught! Pollock strikes first up! Malik tries to smash him over the long off boundary, it was the slower ball and Malik gets under it and hits it high in the air, Nayar is at long off and he takes a well-judged catch, Mumbai have broken a dangerous partnership
the slower ball outside off stump, Malik cuts the ball towards third man for  a single, there's a bit of confusion over the second run but the batsmen are safe in the end
the slower ball in the block hole on off stump, pushed off the front foot towards mid-off
full and wide outside the off stump, Karthik gets on to the front foot and drives the ball powerfully over the infield at cover, splendid bat speed and hence the shot was very well timed
driven uppishly in the air but past the bowler for one more, Nehra mis-fields at long on
the extra bounce outside stump takes Karthik's outside edge, Takawale can't hold on and they run a single towards short third man, difficult chance
short and wide outside off stump, Karthik cuts hard off the back foot but straight at Jayasuriya at point
full length outside off stump, Karthik moves forward and drives the ball into the gap at cover for a single
a low full toss on middle stump, Malik drives the ball towards long on for a single, Delhi reach 100
fuller length on off and middle stump, driven off the front foot towards long on for a single
the slower ball outside off stump, it's much too slow and wide outside off, Karthik has enough time to wait and play the ball fine past the fielder at short third man, four more
full ball in the blockhole outside off stump, Karthik tries to drive towards cover but gets beaten
too short on middle and leg stump, Karthik moves forward and pulls the ball into the gap at deep backward square leg, that was too short from Thornely and Karthik puts it away easily
the slower ball pitches outside leg stump at 113 kmh, Karthik moves across and tries to flick but gets hit on the pad for  a leg bye behind square
good length delivery on off stump, Malik stays in his crease and chops the ball towards third man for  a single
guided towards third man for  a single

good length delivery pitches on middle and angles across the right-hander, Karthik pushes the ball to Jayasuriya at backward point and sets off for the single, Malik sends him back and even though Karthik put in a full length dive he would have been short had Jayasuriya hit the stumps
full ball on leg and middle stump, Malik whips the ball off his pads towards deep backward square leg
short of a length delivery gets big on Karthik from over the wicket, he moves back and across his stumps and nudges to the leg side
good length on middle stump at 101 kmh, played off the pads behind square
pushed off the back foot towards the bowler, Thornely can't stop it cleanly and concedes a single
good length on off stump at no real pace, Malik plays a firm square drive from his crease but straight o the fielder at point
good length delivery outside off stump, Karthik opens the face late to run the ball towards third man
caught! big big wicket for Mumbai! Sehwag pulls a low full toss from outside off stump towards Pollock at midwicket who takes a flat catch, Sehwag goes for 40 off 20 balls
good length ball on off and middle, Malik plays it off his pads towards midwicket and responds to Sehwag's call for a single
that's a nice friendly full toss and Sehwag deposits it in the stands at deep midwicket with a ferocious pull, expensive first over from  Jayasuriya
Malik takes a step down the track and pushes the ball towards long on
full ball outside off stump, Sehwag backs away and drives towards point
driven off the front foot towards long on
bowled flatter through the air, Sehwag hits the ball down the ground to long on

what a welcome he gets! Sehwag steps out of his crease, gets under the ball and lofts Jayasuriya high and extremely far over deep midwicket, he's the tournament's leading scorer now and wins the orange cap from Rohit Sharma

Sehwag's been let off! Malik defended the ball towards point and Sehwag sprinted for the single from the non-striker's end, Malik sent him back, Sehwag was miles out of his crease but the bowler couldn't get back in time and the throw missed the stumps
good length delivery outside off stump, Sehwag opens the face and runs the single to third man
too short and Sehwag has ample time to move across his stumps and pull the ball towards deep backward square leg, the fielder has no chance
fuller length outside off stump, Malik drives towards long off once again for a single
good length delivery on off stump, Malik moves forward and drives the ball firmly towards long off for a quickly run double
short of a length outside off stump, Malik backs away to make room and steers the ball wide of the fielder at third man for four

that's a slower one but Sehwag's spotted it, he backed away towards the leg side to make room and lofted the ball cleanly right over the bowlers head for four, it bounced once before going over the boundary
good length ball bowled straight on middle stump, driven off the front foot towards long off for  a single
Malik spots the slower ball and tries to slog it over deep midwicket, he doesn't time it well but clears the infield, Pollock gives chase

Sehwag moves across his stumps and pulls a short of  a length ball to deep backward square leg, there's a fumble in the deep but the batsmen had run the first slowly and therefore can't capitalise on the fumble
short of a length delivery just outside off stump, Malik moves back in his crease and opens the face to run the ball towards third man
full ball on off stump, Malik moves forward and drives firmly towards cover where Uthappa lets it go through his legs for two runs
sharp short ball, Sehwag was surprised by it and was in no position to play the pull, Kulkarni finishes an excellent first over
short of a length outside off stump, Malik waits in his crease and cuts the ball down to third man for  a single
Malik leans across and flicks a good length ball towards midwicket
excellent ball, in the block hole on middle stump, Sehwag backs away and digs the ball out on the off side for a single
Kulkarni oversteps while bowling a short of a length ball on middle stump, Malik nudges it towards the leg side for one, free hit for Sehwag coming up
flicked off the pads to deep backward square leg

de Villiers is run out! Sehwag smashes a full ball straight back at the bowler who bends down low and gets finger tips to the ball, the ball goes on to uproot the stump at the bowler's end with de Villiers well short of his crease, some people may say that the batsman is unlucky there but if you are backing up too far you have to pay the price at times
width offered outside off stump, de Villiers slashes at it, trying to cut through point but gets a thick bottom edge that runs between the keepers legs for four, lucky boundary for the batsman
de Villiers leans forward and drives a good length ball firmly back to Bravo who fields on his follow through
played off the backfoot behind  point
short and wide outside off stump, de Villiers slashes the ball over point but he hasn't made proper contact, Thornely runs in from the boundary and dives but can't quite reach it, super effort though
short of a length on middle stump, Sehwag moves across his stumps and plays the ball off his hips towards deep backward square leg for  a single
de Villiers moves towards the off side and drives a full ball straight back at Bravo who reaches to his right and makes a sharp stop, they get a single towards mid-on

Sehwag hasn't had much of the strike but when he gets it he makes it count big time! Pollock gives him a bit of width outside off stump, the length is shorter as well and Sehwag frees his arms and slashes the ball over the point boundary, huge six that!
that is the first run of the over, good length ball on middle stump and de Villiers drives towards mid-on who is on the edge of the circle
de Villiers backs away a bit too early to give himself room, Pollock bowls short of  a length over leg stump, de Villiers tries to cut but gets beaten
excellent length from Pollock angling into the right-hander, de Villiers defends on the leg side
good length delivery angles into the right-hander, de Villiers backs away and drives firmly towards cover where Uthappa dives to his left and saves runs
good length delivery on off stump, defended on the front foot towards the off side
fuller length on middle stump, Sehwag waits in his crease and plays the ball towards midwicket, 16 runs off that over from Nehra
awesome! Nehra offers a little bit off width outside off stump, Sehwag moves back and drives the ball powerfully through cover, he hit that on the up and hit it beautifully through the gap
de Villiers moves back in his crease to a good length delivery and opens the face to run the ball towards third man
too full on the pads, de Villiers moves forward and clips the ball sweetly off his pads through midwicket for four

short ball outside off stump angling across the right-hander from over the wicket, de Villiers tries to slash it through point but gets a thick top edge that sails  over the third man boundary for the innings' first six
Nehra pitches outside leg stump and angles into Sehwag's pads, Sehwag moves across his crease and flicks down to long leg for a single
de Villiers moves towards a short of  a length ball outside off and cuts hard but straight to the fielder at backward point
slightly short in length angling into middle stump, de Villiers moves back and across and flicks the ball into the gap at midwicket, he'll get two for the shot
fuller length angling into middle stump, de Villiers leans forward and closes the face of the bat to play the ball towards square leg
good length delivery on off stump, de Villiers moves across the stumps and defends
caught again! Pollock bowls a fullish length on off stump, Dhawan tries to drive the ball through cover but lofts it straight to Uthappa again, Mumbai have made a splendid start
short of a length outside off stump, Dhawan cuts once again but doesn't find the gap at point
slightly short and wide outside off, Dhawan cuts in the air but the ball falls just short of point, the fielder doesn't collect it cleanly and Dhawan runs the single

shot! But caught! The length is full on off stump, Gambhir backs away and tries to drive powerfully through the off side, he's hit that well but straight to Uthappa at cover who takes a sharp catch, Gambhir goes for one
too straight this time on middle and leg stump, Gambhir should have put it away but flicks the ball to Bravo at square leg
short and wide outside the off stump, Gambhir stands in his crease and cuts hard but can't find the gap at point, the off side field is packed
bowled full into Gambhir from over the wicket, Gambhir defends back to the bowler

short wide and smashed! Sehwag latches on to the room outside off stump and slashes the ball towards third man, Nayar sprints to his left and dives to save the boundary, Sehwag had strolled the single because he was sure it was four, excellent save on the boundary
excellent start from Pollock, the last ball is on a good length on off stump, Gambhir moves forward and defends airily towards cover
Gambhir stays in his crease and tries to run the ball towards third man, he plays it to a widish slip
Gambhir charges Pollock and tries to hit him through the off side, he gets beaten, "Oh yeah Polly," says Nayar who is miked up to the commentators
just short of a length outside off stump, Sehwag moves back and opens the face to drive the ball behind point, there's a fielder at deep point for Sehwag
good length once again from Pollock, Gambhir drops it with soft hands towards the off side and calls for the quick single
starts off with a good length delivery that pitches around off stump and seams across the left-hander, Gambhir fends at it and gets beaten
